name: archboard-painting
responsibility: Measures every word a layout places and paints a settled drawing into the scene that every painter draws
description: The archboard-painting crate (ADR 0091), 20 names: the ten Flow part measures, paint, viewer_marks, junction_boxes, own_icons, measure_node, measure_label, diagram_margin, straight_card_top_contains, tab_width and header_padding. The measurer stays with the painter because they share the size sheet (sizes.rs), which is private to the crate: other crates learn a part's size from Flow part measures (ADR 0088) and the few answers above, never from the sheet. Its scene builders are its own, so no other crate sets a run of words.
